note: The beachcomber's trail (doc 13 'Trails', docs/future/12), read by src/world/trails.js and src/world/expansion.js, drawn on the journal's Trails page (src/ui/journal-trails.js). A stop is a first, never a total: the first keepsake of each family kept, the first kept at each rarity (uncommon and up), and the first of each mark seen (a mark counts even when the keepsake is left to the sea); they are written in the saved unlocks' firsts, in order, and never taken back. Each stop has a need: families (so many families kept), rarity (one kept at that rarity), marks (so many marks seen). When it is met, a stop with a give is given once, for good (merged into the saved unlocks: nets.general is the general net), with its title and line as a card and a journal note; built: a stop that has nothing to give but already exists (the shelf) inks when reached; any other stop is not built yet and shows in pencil, 'one day', where it falls. Only the next stop ahead shows, in pencil with its hint. icon: drawn from src/ui/icons. words: the page's words; families, rarities and marks name each first on the trail (a mark's key is family:mark).
